title: Contact your electoral registration office
description: Contact your electoral registration office if you have a question about voting in UK elections or the electoral register.
body:
If you live in Northern Ireland

Check if you’re already registered to vote using the Am I Registered service for Northern Ireland.

Contact the Electoral Office for Northern Ireland (EONI) to opt in or out of the ‘edited register’ - the version of the electoral register that’s available to anyone who wants to buy a copy in Northern Ireland.
